title: Fit to Be Tied - Montana Muscle
author: Tank
desc:
Before you lock it down, you're getting put through a workout that’ll make sure you're more than ready for the adventure ahead. 

Forget cold feet—this is about making sure you got the muscle to to handle everything that’s coming your way. Prepare to be ground down, pumped up, and maybe even puke those pre-wedding jitters out. 

It’s Montana muscle, baby—where soft boys turn into hard men.  

By the end of this, you'll be more than fit to be tied, because if you're gonna say “I do" and kick off the ride of your life, you better be damn well ready to handle everything that comes with it.
